preconditions: Java Engine capability endpoint is reachable
Rootless Runner and separate verifier report configured
steps: enter approved HTTPS Git URL and exact ref
optionally bind a full 40-character commit SHA
observe immutable Commit and Snapshot digest
observe exact Boot/Java/Maven fingerprint and FCM artifact
observe OpenRewrite, source and target tests, bounded repair and independent validation
observe health path and redacted logs
stop or retry from an eligible terminal state
negative_assertions: failed independent validation exposes no download or start action
NOT_RUN is never rendered as READY
runtime start cannot precede independent validation
logs never display recognized token, password, authorization or secret values
